summary: Wiki sync defaults, reliability, and Goals page bootstrap/enforcement (Issue #266 / Epic: beta-roadmap)

entries.surface: bootstrap (Goals page init with planning/apply), health (goals_page_present detection + nudge), docs (checklist, AGENTS, agent guidance), tests
entries.migration_impact: Bootstrap now seeds the Goals wiki page convention (placeholder from template) when wiki is enabled and page absent. Dry-run plans it (interactive decision point); --apply creates the file via GH contents API. Health reports goals_page_present for nudges. Wiki sync guidance and new-repo checklist updated. Existing projects get nudge via health; new ones via bootstrap. Complements prior partial work in #229/#224.
entries.agent_notes: Use gh plate bootstrap (dry shows planned Goals init if applicable; --apply seeds it). Check plate_health or gh plate health for goals_page_present. Agents should reference the Goals page in audits and recommend customizing it. See convention doc and #266 for details. Update AGENTS/plate.agent.md guidance included.
